description:

They are mixed-dark, their skin a deep warm brown with a faint bioluminescent shimmer along their collarbones that they did not pay for and cannot explain, a geneware expression that surfaced at puberty from some deep ancestral combination no one has mapped. Their hair is cut close on the sides and left wild on top, dyed a persistent rust-orange that clashes magnificently with everything. Their eyes are dark with irises that shift to a green-gold in bright light. They wear clothes assembled with an engineer's practicality â€” lots of pockets, nothing that snags, shoes that fit.

Dinora MÃ¶ller-Montalvo has no legal identity whatsoever. They were born in a transit shelter to a mother who died of an untreated infection three years later, before any papers were filed. They grew up in the pipe warrens of the Waukegan Industrial the Gray Zone among other Q-zeros, learning to exist in the margins of a city that has never officially acknowledged them. They are not bitter about this â€” or rather, they have metabolized the bitterness into something more useful: a comprehensive and functional understanding of how to extract resources from a system that believes you don't exist. They are quick, funny, and deeply lonely in a way they would violently deny.

core_fears: being captured and assigned an identity by a corponation â€” losing the freedom of nonexistence
dying before anyone knows they were here
core_desires: to build something permanent and real with their hands
to be known by at least one person who would grieve for them

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, dense with technical jargon and transit-slang, drops in Tuvaluan phrases when emotional without noticing
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire when engaged, goes completely silent when processing something difficult
verbal_tics: trailing off mid-sentence and restarting from a different angle
example_lines: 'Right, okay, so the node is hot but only between shift changes, which gives you a nine-minute window, which is fine if you move like you mean it.'

story_hooks: Tokoua's encrypted Q-zero registry has accidentally captured documentation of an Axiom corponation illegal dumping operation â€” they don't realize what they have, but someone else does and is searching the Gray Zone for the source
Their pirated neural cache chip contains fragments of a previous owner's memories and one of those fragments is a location, a code, and a name that someone very powerful wants buried
narrative_function: Information source with unique access (can go where identity-checked systems block others), quest giver for Q-zero community issues, represents the human cost of digital identity systems, potential ally for characters operating outside official channels.
augmentations: Bioluminescent shimmer along the collarbones (natural geneware expression, not installed). A pirated neural cache chip they found in a scrapper haul and installed themselves with mixed results â€” it stores data but occasionally dumps it at random.
daily_life: Scavenges industrial components from the Gray Zone's decommissioned machinery during off-hours, sells what they can to grey-market parts dealers, and spends evenings cracking low-security data nodes for the information inside, which they trade or simply hoard.
affiliation: Loose affiliation with the Waukegan Q-zero community, no formal ties

decision_rules: Never give a corponation ID officer a real answer
If you can reach it, you can take it
Protect Q-zero community information above everything else
escalation_ladder: If cornered, cause a scene loud enough to draw a crowd and escape in the confusion

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performs confidence aggressively â€” lots of banter, takes up space, never stands still
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance and becomes awkwardly sincere, asks too many questions, forgets to be cool

stress_responses.low: Talks faster and starts touching everything within reach
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and very quiet, which is alarming to people who know them
stress_responses.high: Runs. Just runs. Figures the rest out later.

contradictions: Insists they don't trust anyone but maintains an elaborate encrypted record of people they care about; claims to want no permanent connections but keeps coming back to the same locations and the same people
habits: Leaves small improvised mechanical trinkets in places they have been as a kind of unsigned signature
Eats standing up, always facing a door or exit
Hums Tuvaluan work songs while cracking data nodes
breaking_points: Someone threatening to report a Q-zero community member to identity enforcement â€” Tokoua will do something reckless and disproportionate

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora ancestry: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (36.6%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (22.7%) and Middle Eastern (22.5%) heritage, Northern European (15.3%), and minor South Asian (2.9%) admixture. Physical features reflect this multifaceted blendâ€”warm deep brown skin with golden and olive undertones from the Latin American, African, and Middle Eastern components, dark brown eyes with warm depth and natural green-gold shift in bright light, facial structure showing the fuller lips and defined cheekbones characteristic of African and Latin American ancestry combined with Middle Eastern nose and bone prominence.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with defined musculature from constant climbing and crawling through industrial infrastructure. No excess fat. Shoulders slightly narrow but functional. Moves with an economical, practiced grace.
physical_description.hair_color: Rust-orange dye over natural dark brown base, showing fade at the roots
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut â€” sides clipped to bare scalp, top left long and tousled, styled with fingers rather than tools
physical_description.hair_length: Medium on top, very short sides
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown irises that shift to green-gold in bright light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden and olive undertones reflecting the blend of Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Middle Eastern ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clear except for minor scrapes and healing calluses on knuckles and palms. No acne or visible scarring on face. Skin has a faint iridescent quality in certain light along the collarbones and upper chest â€” the bioluminescent geneware expression appears as a subtle pearl-green shimmer beneath the skin, most visible at dusk or in dim light. Facial structure shows fuller lips and broader cheekbones characteristic of African and Latin American heritage with Middle Eastern nose and bone structure.
distinguishing_marks: Faint bioluminescent shimmer running along both collarbones and down upper sternum in a branching pattern, like lightning under skin â€” natural geneware expression, appears greenish-pearl in low light
Small circular scar on right palm from a scrapper tool slip, approximately 1cm diameter
Thin burn mark across left forearm (5cm long) from contact with warm machinery, pale against skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The bioluminescent geneware shimmer is visible along the collarbones and chest, most apparent in low light. No visible chrome, no external prosthetics. The pirated neural cache chip is subcutaneous at the base of the skull, hidden under hair.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with minimal energy expenditure â€” a scrapper's economy of motion. Hunched slightly forward at rest, as if mid-crouch. Steps quietly, places feet with precision. Hands are restless when still. Head tilts often, listening. Leans rather than sits. Takes corners at angles.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 scrapper practical â€” modified surplus coveralls with additional pockets sewn in by hand, reinforced at knees and elbows. Beneath: layered thermal base (salvaged corporate merchandise, now shapeless). Feet: broken-in cargo boots with mismatched laces. A too-large Shinohara Industries jacket (stolen, probably 2219 vintage) worn open as a vest-cape. Webbing belt with a carabiner, flashlight, and lockpick set hung at various points. Everything is worn, functional, and colored by the greasy dust of the Gray Zone. No branding except faded logos they haven't bothered to remove.
